title: LEGIT AC1 mechanical 105 ride comparison with WINSPACE M6
notes: Exact AC1 trial within a broader M6/UNAAS comparison, published2026-05-10 and updated2026-08-26. Photograph/caption identify the AC1 mechanical105 trial bike, sizeM with alloy handlebar and UNAAS wheels. Reviewer feels greater rear vibration absorption than M6, but slower handling; attributes much of front-end response to mechanical shifters and alloy bar, with size also affecting comparison. Subjective whole-bike comparison, not isolated frame stiffness or numeric measurement. Affiliate participation disclosed. Worker and parent read the AC1 section.
